questions.question: Which film do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Marlin crosses the ocean to find his son Nemo, with forgetful Dory along for the ride.

questions.question: Which film do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Elsa and Anna are sisters, and Olaf is a snowman who dreams of summer.

questions.question: What is the name of the cowboy doll in Toy Story?
questions.explanation: Woody is voiced by Tom Hanks, and Bullseye is his horse.

questions.question: In The Lion King, what kind of animal is Pumbaa?
questions.explanation: Pumbaa's best friend Timon is the meerkat, and together they sing Hakuna Matata.

questions.question: Which film do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: WALL-E is a little robot left tidying up an empty Earth, until a tiny plant changes everything.

questions.question: In Despicable Me, what are Gru's little yellow helpers called?
questions.explanation: The Minions chatter away in their own silly language, made from bits of lots of real ones.

questions.question: Which film do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Po is a noodle-loving panda who becomes the Dragon Warrior.

questions.question: Which country did Paddington Bear come from before he arrived in London?
questions.explanation: He came from darkest Peru, where his Aunt Lucy raised him, and stowed away to London living on marmalade.

questions.question: Who plays Willy Wonka in the 2023 film Wonka?
questions.explanation: Gene Wilder played Wonka in 1971 and Johnny Depp in 2005.

questions.question: In Inside Out 2, which new emotion tries to take charge of Riley's mind?
questions.explanation: Anxiety turns up with Envy, Ennui and Embarrassment when Riley turns 13.

questions.question: In Shrek, who does Donkey fall in love with?
questions.explanation: Donkey and Dragon later have babies who are part donkey and part dragon.

questions.question: In Moana, what is the name of the very silly rooster?
questions.explanation: Heihei stows away on Moana's boat, while Pua the pig stays at home.

questions.question: In How to Train Your Dragon, what kind of dragon is Toothless?
questions.explanation: Nobody on Berk had ever seen a Night Fury until Hiccup found Toothless.

questions.question: In the film Sing, what kind of animal is the theatre owner Buster Moon?
questions.explanation: Buster Moon puts on a singing competition to save his theatre.

questions.question: Which film do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Luca is a young sea monster who looks human on dry land and dreams of riding a Vespa around Italy.

questions.question: Which film won the very first Academy Award for Best Picture?
questions.explanation: Wings, a silent film about First World War pilots, won at the first Oscars in 1929.

questions.question: Which film do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: James Cameron's Titanic won 11 Oscars, a record it shares with Ben-Hur and The Return of the King.

questions.question: Who directed Jaws, E.T. and Jurassic Park?
questions.explanation: Steven Spielberg was just 27 when he shot Jaws.

questions.question: Who played the travel bookshop owner in Notting Hill?
questions.explanation: Hugh Grant plays William Thacker, and Rhys Ifans steals scenes as his flatmate Spike.

questions.question: Which film do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Scientists bring dinosaurs back from DNA found in mosquitoes trapped in amber.

questions.question: Who played Captain Jack Sparrow in the Pirates of the Caribbean films?
questions.explanation: Johnny Depp was nominated for the Best Actor Oscar for the very first film.

questions.question: Which film do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Dorothy's ruby slippers were silver in L. Frank Baum's original book.

questions.question: Which film do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Doc Brown's DeLorean has to hit 88 miles per hour to travel through time.

questions.question: Which London-born director made Inception, Interstellar and Oppenheimer?
questions.explanation: Oppenheimer won him the Oscars for Best Director and Best Picture in 2024.

questions.question: Which Danny Boyle film won the Oscar for Best Picture?
questions.explanation: Slumdog Millionaire won eight Oscars in 2009, including Best Director for Boyle.

questions.question: Which actor wrote the script for Rocky and refused to sell it unless he could play the boxer himself?
questions.explanation: Rocky went on to win the Oscar for Best Picture, beating Taxi Driver and All the President's Men.

questions.question: In which city is the 1971 Michael Caine film Get Carter mostly set?
questions.explanation: Caine plays a London gangster who goes home to Newcastle after his brother's death.

questions.question: Which actor played James Bond in the most official Eon Bond films?
questions.explanation: Roger Moore made seven, from Live and Let Die to A View to a Kill.

questions.question: Which is the only Alfred Hitchcock film to win the Oscar for Best Picture?
questions.explanation: Rebecca won in 1941, but Hitchcock himself never won a competitive Oscar for directing.

questions.question: In Casablanca, what is the name of the pianist at Rick's café?
questions.explanation: Nobody in the film actually says 'Play it again, Sam': Ilsa says 'Play it, Sam'.
